{
 "path": "programs/task-4c290c45.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Full-width/full-height color-4 lines partition the canvas into tiles.
    sep=4
    rs=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==sep for c in range(w))]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==sep for r in range(h))]
    rb=[0]+[r+1 for r in rs]
    re=rs+[h]
    cb=[0]+[c+1 for c in cs]
    ce=cs+[w]
    tiles=[]
    for i,(r0,r1) in enumerate(zip(rb,re)):
      for j,(c0,c1) in enumerate(zip(cb,ce)):
        if r1>r0 and c1>c0:
          tiles.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    # Choose the occupied tile as the motif; copy it into every matching-sized tile.
    source=None
    for t in tiles:
      r0,r1,c0,c1=t
      if any(g[r][c]!=sep and g[r][c]!=g[0][0] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
        source=t; break
    if source is None: return g
    r0,r1,c0,c1=source
    motif=[row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
    bg=g[0][0]
    for a,b,x,y in tiles:
      if (b-a,x-y)!=(r1-r0,c1-c0): continue
      for dr in range(b-a):
        for dc in range(y-x):
          if motif[dr][dc]!=bg and motif[dr][dc]!=sep:
            g[a+dr][x+dc]=motif[dr][dc]
    return g
"
}
